Rear elevations, concealed connections and exact dimensions remain inferred; the source does not verify them.</assessment>

action: Extend the pale projecting grid and recessed glazing across the source-visible elevations, matching their floor and bay rhythm and darker lower zone. action: Add those visible envelope features to the existing neighbor, retaining its placement beside the tower.</issue>
<keep>Tower placement to the right of the descending wing.
Beige neighbor placement immediately to the tower’s right.</keep>
